item.title: NYC unveils records suggesting officials knew air was unsafe after 9/11
item.description: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani's administration released over 170,000 pages of documents Tuesday suggesting city officials knew air conditions were unsafe.

item.title: Body image pressures intensify in 2026 as extreme thinness returns
item.description: A renewed focus on extreme thinness is reducing body diversity in media, echoing early 2000s fashion trends and raising mental health concerns.

item.title: Sports become battleground in America's political conflicts
item.description: This summer, the WNBA, MLB, and a golf startup served as proxies for national political disputes, reflecting deeper societal divisions.

item.title: Smithsonian Secretary Lonnie Bunch to step down after White House tensions
item.description: Lonnie Bunch, Secretary of the Smithsonian, announced his retirement later this year following disagreements with the White House, marking a significant leadership change.
